generate_text_with_remote_llm: generate text by sending a message to a remote FastChat LLM worker via HTTP POST
summarize_image_description: summarize an image description into a concise 65-word summary using the remote language model
create_negative_captions: create altered negative captions from an image description using basic, layout, or swaps prompt types
extract_numbered_captions: extract five numbered captions from a multi-caption LLM response string into a list
reduce_caption_length: reduce a caption to a target token count by iteratively summarizing with the remote LLM
